candidate_relations.reason: The benchmark is urticarial vasculitis; plain urticaria omits the defining small-vessel vasculitis and purpuric features.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Urticarial eruption without the required vasculitic component

candidate_relations.reason: Erythema multiforme is a targetoid eruption and does not represent urticarial vasculitis.
There was no bite history or animal contact, and an insect bite reaction is not the benchmark vasculitic disorder.
Dermatitis herpetiformis typically causes grouped pruritic papulovesicles on extensor sites and is distinct from urticarial vasculitis.
